dexId.description: The unique ID to specify the decentralized exchange (DEX) within a particular blockchain. Find more [here](https://docs.blockdaemon.com/docs/defi-api-supported-protocols#supported-dexs-protocols).

tokenA.description: Address of the first token being removed.

tokenB.description: Address of the second token being removed.

liquidity.description: Amount of liquidity pool (LP) tokens to remove, specified in the token's smallest denomination (base units). Examples: 1 LP token (18 decimals) = "1000000000000000000".

amountAMin.description: Minimum acceptable amount of token A in the token's smallest denomination (base units). Provides slippage protection — the transaction reverts if the deposited amount falls below this value. Set to "0" to disable slippage protection.

amountBMin.description: Minimum acceptable amount of token B in the token's smallest denomination (base units). Provides slippage protection — the transaction reverts if the deposited amount falls below this value. Set to "0" to disable slippage protection.

deadline.description: Deadline for the transaction to be executed (UNIX Timestamp).

to.description: Address of the recipient of the token.

from.description: Address of the sender of the token.

gas.description: Maximum number of gas units to allocate for the transaction, as an integer string (e.g., '200000'). If omitted, gas is estimated automatically. Note: this is gas units, not wei or gwei.

gasPriority.description: Specifies the priority level for gas fees (e.g., 'low', 'medium', or 'high'), which influences the transaction speed and cost.

slippage.description: Percentage of total value allowed for slippage. Default is 1. Range: 0 <= slippage <= 100.

enableFee.description: Flag to include a basis points fee transaction alongside the main transaction when set to true.

tokenId.description: The token ID for Uniswap V3 liquidity position.

amountAMax.description: Maximum amount of token A in the token's smallest denomination (base units).

amountBMax.description: Maximum amount of token B in the token's smallest denomination (base units).

amountADesired.description: Desired amount of token A to add as liquidity, specified in the token's smallest denomination (base units). Do not send human-readable decimal values. Examples: 1 WETH (18 decimals) = "1000000000000000000"; 1 USDC (6 decimals) = "1000000".

amountBDesired.description: Desired amount of token B to add as liquidity, specified in the token's smallest denomination (base units). Do not send human-readable decimal values. Examples: 1 WETH (18 decimals) = "1000000000000000000"; 1 USDC (6 decimals) = "1000000".

path.description: Array of token contract addresses for the liquidity pool. Provide [tokenAAddress, tokenBAddress]. Example (LINK/USDC): ['0x514910771AF9Ca656af840dff83E8264EcF986CA', '0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48'].

amountIn.description: Amount of tokens to add as liquidity, specified in the token's smallest denomination (base units). Do not send human-readable decimal values. Examples: 1 WETH (18 decimals) = "1000000000000000000"; 1 USDC (6 decimals) = "1000000".

amountOut.description: Amount of the output token to receive, specified in the token's smallest denomination (base units). Do not send human-readable decimal values. Examples: 1 WETH (18 decimals) = "1000000000000000000"; 1 USDC (6 decimals) = "1000000".

toInternalBalance.description: True if receiving tokens as internal token balances. False if receiving as ERC20.

ids.description: Bin IDs that liquidity should be removed from.

amounts.description: Array of token amounts to remove as liquidity, each specified in the token's smallest denomination (base units). Examples: 1 WETH (18 decimals) = "1000000000000000000"; 1 USDC (6 decimals) = "1000000".

positionNFT.description: LP token that represents a position in a pool.

amountOutMin.description: Minimum acceptable output amount in the token's smallest denomination (base units). Provides slippage protection — the transaction reverts if the output falls below this value. Set to "0" to disable slippage protection. Examples: to require at least 0.99 USDC (6 decimals), use "990000"; to require at least 0.99 WETH (18 decimals), use "990000000000000000".

poolFees.description: Different pool based on the fees. By default, it is selected as 2500.
